articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 06 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_06_Ground_Control_Station/Chapter_06_Ground_Control_Stat…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 06 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_06_Ground_Control_Station/Chapter_06_Ground_Control_Station_KR.md Volume 18. Cargo UAV Architecture Chapter 06. Ground Control Station 06.01. GCS Architecture 지상통제소(Ground Control Station, GCS)는 인간 운용자(Human Operator)와 무인항공기(Unmanned Aircraft)를 연결하는 지상의 지휘(Command), 감독(Supervision), 임무 관리(Mission Management) 환경이다. 화물 무인항공기(Cargo UAV) 시스템에서 GCS는 단순한 항공기 조종 이상의 기능을 지원해야 한다. 항공기가 고가 또는 안전 필수 화물(Safety-Critical Payload)을 탑재한 상태로 장거리 자율 물류 임무(Long-Range Autonomous Logistics Mission)를 수행할 수 있기 때문이다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Cargo UAV Architecture — Ch.05: Cargo Management System [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 05 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_05_Cargo_Management_System/Chapter_05_Cargo_Management_S…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 05 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_05_Cargo_Management_System/Chapter_05_Cargo_Management_System_KR.md Volume 18. Cargo UAV Architecture Chapter 05. Cargo Management System 05.01. Cargo Weight Sensor 화물 중량 센서(Cargo Weight Sensor)는 항공기가 이륙하기 전에 실제 탑재중량(Payload)을 정확하게 파악하고, 가능한 경우 운항 중에도 이를 지속적으로 감시해야 하기 때문에 화물 관리 시스템(Cargo Management System)의 핵심 구성요소이다. 화물 무인항공기(Cargo UAV)에서 측정된 중량은 허용 총중량(Gross Mass), 요구 추력(Required Thrust), 에너지 소비(Energy Consumption), 비행거리(Flight Range), 구조 하중(Structural Loading), 임무 계획(Mission Plan)의 유효성에 직접적인 영향을 미친다. 센싱 아키텍처(Sensing Architecture)는 일반적으로 화물 인터페이스(Cargo Interface)에 작용하는 기계적 하중(Mechanical Loading)을 전기적 측정값(Electrical Measurement)으로 변환한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Valve Secures Staging Server Files to Prevent Unauthorized Data-Mining of Unreleased Dota 2 Assets
articles.excerpt: The Staging Server Breach: Anatomy of a Dota 2 Leak The recurring exposure of unreleased Dota 2 assets—exemplified by the premature surfacing of the Juggernaut persona and Furion arcana—is not a rando…
articles.body: The Staging Server Breach: Anatomy of a Dota 2 Leak The recurring exposure of unreleased Dota 2 assets—exemplified by the premature surfacing of the Juggernaut persona and Furion arcana —is not a random stroke of community serendipity. It is the predictable mechanical outcome of structural leakage within Valve's update deployment pipeline. When staging server client files are synchronized with public-facing content distribution endpoints, the underlying manifest architecture acts as an open book for automated data-mining tools. To understand how assets from files like readonly_tools_asset_info.bin.full.staging.txt end up public on community mirrors such as the muk-as/DOTA2_CLIENT repository, one must trace the causal chain of an update build.
articles.author: Dan Balan

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 04 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_04_Flight_Control_System/Chapter_04_Flight_Control_Syste…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 04 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_04_Flight_Control_System/Chapter_04_Flight_Control_System_KR.md Volume 18. Cargo UAV Architecture Chapter 04. Flight Control System 04.01. Flight Control Computer 비행제어컴퓨터(Flight Control Computer, FCC)는 무인항공기(UAV) 비행제어시스템(Flight Control System)의 실시간 연산 핵심으로서, 항공기 상태 정보와 임무 수준 명령을 결정론적 액추에이터 명령(Deterministic Actuator Command)으로 변환한다. 화물 무인항공기(Cargo UAV)에서 FCC는 외란, 센서 오류, 탑재화물 변화, 통신 두절 및 특정 장비 고장이 발생하더라도 제어 가능한 비행 상태를 유지해야 한다. 따라서 엄격하게 관리되는 항공전자(Avionics) 환경에서 고속 연산, 결정론적 실행, 고장 감시 및 안전 중심 인터페이스를 통합한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 03 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_03_Aerospace_Protocols/Chapter_03_Aerospace_Protocols_KR…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 03 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_03_Aerospace_Protocols/Chapter_03_Aerospace_Protocols_KR.md Volume 18. Cargo UAV Architecture Chapter 03. Aerospace Protocols 03.01. ARINC 429 in UAV ARINC 429는 민간 항공전자(Civil Avionics) 분야에서 항공기 하위 시스템 간에 결정론적(Deterministic)이고 저속(Low-Rate)인 정보를 전송하기 위해 널리 사용되는 성숙한 디지털 데이터 버스(Digital Data Bus) 표준이다. 화물 무인항공기(Cargo UAV)에서는 비행제어컴퓨터(Flight Control Computer), 항법장치(Navigation Unit), 대기자료시스템(Air Data System), 엔진 또는 추진 제어기(Propulsion Controller), 상태 감시장치(Monitoring Equipment), 임무 항공전자장비(Mission Avionics) 사이에 단순하고 예측 가능한 인터페이스를 제공할 수 있다. ARINC 429의 가치는 높은 대역폭보다는 안정적인 타이밍, 전기적 견고성, 그리고 오랜 기간 확립된 항공전자 통합 방식에 있다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Cargo UAV Architecture — Ch.02: Avionics Architecture [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 02 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_02_Avionics_Architecture/Chapter_02_Avionics_Architectur…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 07 · Volume 18 · Chapter 02 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/07_Vol_18_Cargo_UAV_Architecture/blob/main/Chapter_02_Avionics_Architecture/Chapter_02_Avionics_Architecture_KR.md Volume 18. Cargo UAV Architecture Chapter 02. Avionics Architecture 02.01. FCC/FMC Architecture 비행 제어 컴퓨터(Flight Control Computer, FCC)와 비행 관리 컴퓨터(Flight Management Computer, FMC)는 화물 무인항공기(Cargo UAV)의 항공전자 아키텍처(Avionics Architecture)에서 서로 보완적인 두 개의 연산 영역(Computational Domain)을 구성한다. FCC는 항공기의 실시간 안정화(Real-time Stabilization)와 제어(Control)를 담당하고, FMC는 상위 수준의 임무(Mission), 항법(Navigation), 궤적(Trajectory), 운용 목표(Operational Objective)를 관리한다. 이러한 영역 분리는 결정론적 비행 제어 기능(Deterministic Flight-Control Function)을 복잡한 임무 관리 연산 부하로부터 보호할 수 있게 한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: I tested Meta Muse and ChatGPT Dots, and here’s the one I’m sticking with
articles.excerpt: AI agent are here to stay.
articles.body: I’m the first to admit I was late to the game when it came to integrating AI into my life. AI tools on my smartphone felt (and still feel) useless and left a sour taste in my mouth. Large language models I used on my desktop, such as ChatGPT and Claude, showed significantly more promise, but they didn’t feel like something casual users would adopt easily. That’s changed over the last couple of months. I’ve ramped up my Codex usage, and I’ve become interested in chat agents designed to bring powerful AI features and functionality to users who aren’t necessarily up to date on the latest from Anthropic and OpenAI. These new agents are easier to use, look friendlier, and promise to be more proactive.
articles.author: Stephen Radochia

Well, there's a Steam game focused on exactly that, and it probably deserves more success than it's managed in the four years since it launched. articles.title: See Jupiter and Mars make a spectacular close approach overnight Nov. 15-16
articles.excerpt: The red planet Mars will shine a little over 1 degree from Jupiter on the night of Nov. 15-16.
articles.body: Heads up stargazers! Mars meets Jupiter for a spectacular rendezvous in the heart of the constellation Leo on the night of Nov. 15-16, and they won't be this close again until July 2029. Jupiter and Mars will appear a little over 1 degree from each other as they rise over the eastern horizon around midnight for viewers in the U.S., as the blue-white light of the main-sequence star Regulus glows below, according to In-The-Sky . It's all a trick of perspective, but spectacular nonetheless. In reality Mars and Jupiter are separated by a gulf of over 368 million miles (592 million kilometers), while the light from Regulus has travelled for some 79 light-years before reaching Earth .
articles.author: Anthony Wood

articles.title: Vela Maps is the closest thing to Google Maps without Google — here’s how to install it
articles.excerpt: This open-source app looks, feels, and acts like Google Maps, but it's more than just a copy.
articles.body: I’d argue that there are at least two apps on Android for every available niche; you just need to find them. This is true for most products, but the one that I’ve found most difficult to replace is Google Maps . My favorite Google app by far, Maps is useful for commuters, explorers, tourists, and restaurateurs. It includes info beyond mere navigation and community input that adds further richness to the experience. It’s a hugely capable and unique app that provides an almost unrivaled experience. “Almost” is the key word here.
articles.author: Andy Walker

articles.title: Breaking Down Theo's Shock Moment in The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 and the Mystery of His Father With Actor Tyroe Muhafidin
articles.excerpt: A spoiler-filled The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 interview with Theo actor Tyroe Muhafidin.
articles.body: Warning! Spoilers for The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 Episodes 1-4 follow. If you’re caught up with The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power , you’ll have watched Season 3, Episode 4 and were probably left reeling by a shock character death that leaves the elves in a spot of bother going into the final stretch. During the first four episodes of Season 3, we see Theo, played by Tyroe Muhafidin, tempted by Sauron into becoming a Nazgnagôl. Nazgnagôl are men who wear one of Sauron’s Rings of Power, but still retain something of their humanity. That is, they are not fully Nazgûl, or Ringwraiths, as we know of the beings in the Third Age of J. R. R. Tolkien's Middle-earth. They are, at this stage, Ring Servants.
articles.author: Wesley Yin-Poole

articles.title: 5 apps you can use instead of Google Messages
articles.excerpt: These apps might not have RCS, but they stand out in other ways.
articles.body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority Google Messages is easily one of the best messaging apps for Android, and RCS support is a large part of the reason. While Samsung used to support RCS directly, these days the only true RCS solution for Android is Google’s official app. As much as RCS has improved Android messaging, I understand that not everyone has bought into the standard. If you’re not concerned about RCS support, there are plenty of other great messaging apps out there as well. Let’s take a look at a few of the best messaging apps out there. To keep things interesting, we’ll take a look at both SMS-based apps and those that use proprietary formats via the web.

articles.title: Apple's Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
articles.excerpt: Dan Erickson and Ben Stiller changed how we see Apple TV forever with the sci-fi powerhouse series 'Severance.'
articles.body: In 2022, Apple was three years into its streaming experiment and still trying to find its footing. Aside from Ted Lasso , the tech giant hadn't released any breakout hits. And while a few sci-fi shows like For All Mankind and Foundation had fans, they weren't exactly mainstream success stories. Then everything changed when Apple took a bet on an unknown showrunner (with backing from an A-list actor) to create something revolutionary.
articles.author: Aimee Hart

articles.title: 20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History
articles.excerpt: Twenty years ago, Battlestar Galactica topped the Adama Maneuver by transforming the Pegasus into an enormous battering ram.
articles.body: Two decades later, this spectacle from Battlestar Galactica season 3’s “Exodus, Part 2” remains unforgettable sci-fi TV. It’s dazzling and horrifying, and still one of the coolest things ever broadcast on science-fiction television. From a tactical standpoint, the “Adama Maneuver” is absolutely bonkers and one of the riskiest spaceship tactics, perhaps ever (sorry, Vice-Admiral Holdo). What if the ship had gotten torn apart from ripping through the atmosphere? What if the FTL drive malfunctioned or didn’t activate in time? Somehow, it’s also not even the most visually impressive sequence in the episode.
articles.author: Corey Plante

articles.title: Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next

articles.body: By now, you’ve probably had time to play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on the Nintendo Switch 2. You’ve marveled at what a great job it does of bringing the classic Nintendo 64 adventure to a new generation, with visual improvements and quality-of-life changes to make it more palatable for that new audience. Maybe you’ve even run through it a second time.

articles.title: SpaceX launches Starship on ambitious 22-hour Flight 15 test, but aborts booster 'chopsticks' catch (video)
articles.excerpt: SpaceX's Starship megarocket reached orbit today (Nov. 13) during its 15th test flight, but the company scrapped a plan to catch the vehicle's massive booster back at the launch site.
articles.body: STARBASE, Texas — SpaceX launched the 15th test flight of its massive Starship rocket today (Nov. 13) and is preparing the vehicle's upper stage for its first-ever return to the launch site in less than 24 hours. Flight 15 lifted off from SpaceX 's Starbase facility here in South Texas at 5:47 p.m. ET (2247 GMT; 4:47 p.m. local Texas time). The towering Super Heavy booster and Ship upper stage cleared the tower without incident and climbed into the skies under more than 18 million pounds of thrust from the booster's 33 Raptor 3 engines. The flight continued nominally through its initial ascent, with the successful execution of Super Heavy's main engine cutoff and Ship's subsequent hot-staging — firing its own Raptors during separation from the booster — about 2.5 minutes after launch.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 13, 1971: NASA's Mariner 9 becomes 1st spacecraft to orbit Mars, revealing close looks at the Martian surface
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 13, 1971, Mariner 9 became the first spacecraft to orbit Mars. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 13, 1971, Mariner 9 became the first spacecraft to orbit Mars. At the time, scientists didn't know much about the Red Planet. NASA had several Mars flybys before Mariner 9 . Those flybys showed that Mars had a cratered surface , so some scientists thought that Mars looked just like the moon. Then Mariner 9 blew blew their minds. When Mariner 9 got to Mars , it arrived in the middle of a dust storm. It saw some tall structures sticking through the clouds. When the dust settled, images from Mariner 9 revealed that these structures were the tops of huge volcanoes. One volcano, Olympus Mons , is the tallest in the solar system. Mariner 9 also spotted an enormous canyon called Valles Marineris . This canyon is five times longer than the Grand Canyon in Arizona.

articles.title: 60 years ago the Leonid meteor shower produced 144,000 meteors per hour. Could it happen again?
articles.excerpt: 60 years ago, the Leonid meteor shower unleashed one of the most spectacular meteor storms in recorded history. As the 2026 peak approaches, here's what skywatchers can expect.
articles.body: This year marks a rather auspicious anniversary for meteor watchers. Sixty years ago , one of the most stupendous Leonid meteor displays lit up the predawn skies over the central and western U.S. So, what will the 2026 Leonids bring us? And what might they bring in the years to come? The Leonid meteor shower is one of the most celebrated of the year's annual displays of "shooting stars." The mere mention of the Leonids usually elicits mental images of a sky filled with shooting stars pouring down through the sky like rain. Such meteor storms have indeed occurred with the Leonids, such as in 1833 and 1966 when meteor rates of tens of thousands per hour were observed.

articles.body: Rocket Lab just hit the century mark. The mission, which Rocket Lab called "The Mountain God Rises," was a big one: It marked the 100th launch to date for the California-based company. articles.title: 'Arrival' at 10: Denis Villeneuve's alien visitation classic that reminded us it's good to talk
articles.excerpt: How the 'Dune' director turned a little-known short story into one of the best sci-fi movies of the 21st century
articles.body: In many of the biggest science fiction franchises, conversing with alien races is an absolute doddle. In " Star Trek ", universal translators come as standard, while C-3PO has spent the last 49 years reminding everyone in "Star Wars" that he's fluent in over six million forms of communication. But in "Arrival" — which was released 10 years ago in November 2016 — making first contact proves to be rather more challenging than maintaining your Duolingo streak. In fact, working out how to establish a dialogue with extraterrestrial visitors becomes the whole point of this powerful and heartbreaking story, as the fate of planet Earth hinges on the interpretation of a single noun.

articles.title: California's brand-new Air & Space Center, home of the space shuttle Endeavour, opens today
articles.excerpt: The California Science Center's brand-new Samuel Oschin Air & Space Center —the home of NASA's space shuttle Endeavour —officially opened to the public today (Nov. 13).
articles.body: LOS ANGELES — The California Science Center officially opened its brand-new Samuel Oschin Air & Space Center to the public today (Nov. 13). After more than three decades in development, folks can finally visit the Los Angeles science museum's massive new wing. For most of us, the biggest draw is its centerpiece: the retired space shuttle Endeavour , sitting upright in launch position, towering at nearly 200 feet (61 meters) tall. "It just takes your breath away when you see that reveal and the doors open and you get to look at it for the first time. It's just — it's overwhelming," former NASA astronaut Garrett Reisman told Space.com during a visit to the museum. Reisman flew on two space shuttle missions during his astronaut career, the first of which was on Endeavour.

articles.title: Windows 0-day dropped by disgruntled researcher hands hackers System rights
articles.excerpt: "SignDrop" exploit lets local users gain all-powerful System rights.
articles.body: Nightmare Eclipse, the pseudonym of a researcher with an ongoing, very public beef with Microsoft, has dropped yet another Windows zero-day. On Tuesday, Nightmare Eclipse disclosed SignDrop, a vulnerability that gives local users full System rights on some versions of Windows. The vulnerability resides in the Common Log File System , which Microsoft describes as a “general-purpose logging service used by software clients running in user-mode or kernel-mode.” By forcing a privileged process such as Windows Defender to open a crafted CLFS container, an attacker with ordinary user rights can abuse the privileged file creation to elevate privileges to System. Turning a Windows defense against itself The attack exploits the interaction of CLFS, Windows Defender, and Windows file permissions.
